experiment: label-free pi05_libero -> PaliGemma alignment; color validation first
paired_prompt: cleaned original robot instruction + newline; same in both models
ridge_selection: validation paired-state MSE only; no answer labels
probe: mean-pool 256 Source tokens; separate binary ridge classifier; validation chooses regularization

fresh_test.requirement: reject previously used suite/task/init; no fitting/selection on new test answers

report: candidate BAcc and short-answer generation separately; pairs and donor following

self_readout_gate.scope: previous calibration data only; this does not establish cross-model alignment

old_test_policy: previous test data is not used for fitting or validation
limitations: a learned map is not training-free
a readout does not establish action causality or first semantic layer
